item.title: Guyana 2040: From Resource Wealth to Strategic Statecraft
item.description: An independent framework for translating Guyana's resource wealth into enduring institutional, productive and national capabilities.

item.title: Guyana Power Demand 2030
item.description: An evidence-led assessment that separates measured demand from development scenarios and evaluates generation and grid requirements through 2030.

item.title: Critical Minerals Are the New Energy Security
item.description: A research monograph examining mining, processing concentration, trade, investment, circular supply and governance across strategic mineral value chains.

item.title: Guyana Economy 2030
item.description: An independent analysis of the choices, assumptions and risks involved in converting exceptional resource revenue into durable national prosperity.

item.title: The New Geography of Globalization
item.description: A comparative study of trade, industrial policy, investment, technology and supply-chain restructuring in a period of geopolitical fragmentation.

item.title: Water Security as Economic Security
item.description: A systems analysis of water risk across agriculture, energy, industry, AI infrastructure, finance, trade and national resilience to 2040.

item.title: Guyana's Low Carbon Development Strategy 2030
item.description: An independent evidence review of forest conservation, carbon finance, national development and governance accountability under Guyana's Low Carbon Development Strategy 2030.

item.title: Guyana's Forest Carbon Economy: Carbon Credits, National Development, Market Integrity and Long-Term Climate Accountability
item.description: Independent research into Guyana's jurisdictional forest-carbon programme, accounting integrity, commercial agreements, revenue governance and long-term climate accountability.

item.title: Guyana's Global Biodiversity Alliance: From the Georgetown Declaration to a Global Architecture for Nature Finance, Biodiversity Data and 30x30 Delivery
item.description: An independent review of Guyana's Global Biodiversity Alliance, its governance, financing arrangements, biodiversity measurement, Indigenous participation and implementation questions.

item.title: Who Pays for the Energy Transition? A Decision Framework for Fair Costs, Reliable Power, Fiscal Durability and Measurable Results
item.description: An independent decision framework for assessing who finances energy-transition infrastructure, who carries risk and how to evaluate affordability, reliability and public outcomes.

item.title: Omai Gold 2026 PEA: From Preliminary Economics to Verifiable Development Readiness
item.description: An independent technical, financial and environmental review of Omai Gold's August 2026 preliminary economic assessment; not a certified mineral reserve estimate or investment recommendation.
